Let me consider this question about Edward VIII's abdication.

Edward VIII became King of the United Kingdom in January 1936 after his father George V died. He abdicated in December 1936 to marry Wallis Simpson, an American divorcée, which caused a constitutional crisis. He signed the Instrument of Abdication on December 10, 1936, and it took effect on December 11, 1936.

Looking at the other agents' answers:
- Three agents (2, 3, and 4) answered 1936 with high confidence (0.97-1.00)
- One agent (1) answered 1937 with 0.92 confidence
